name: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol
short_description: A2A (Agent2Agent) is an open protocol, hosted by the Linux Foundation, that lets AI agents built on different platforms discover each other and delegate tasks, using standard web technologies such as HTTP and JSON-RPC. It complements MCP, which connects an agent to tools and data.

evidence.quote: it's powered by a protocol called A2A
A2A stands for agent to agent. It's an open protocol that lets AI agents talk directly to each other
Finally, there's the agent to agent protocol Google launched A2A in April 2025.
